rebrand.body: Same project, new name, and its browser extension is now Rayburst Connect. Install Rayburst fresh: settings, tasks and history don't carry over, and updating from inside the old app may leave it or its shortcuts behind.
hero.description: An open-source download manager for files, torrents and live streams, native on macOS, Windows and Linux.
ov.title: One app for everything you download
ov.sub: Files, torrents and live streams in one fast, native window
ov.p1.d: All, in progress, failed and completed, each with a live count
ov.p2.d: Progress, speed, time left and connections on every card
ov.p3.d: Sort, resume, pause or remove tasks in one click
ov.p4.d: Total upload and download speed, with the current limits beside it
proto.title: Every protocol, one list
proto.sub: Paste anything from HTTPS to magnet to a live HLS feed, and watch it land
details.title: Nothing happens out of sight
details.sub: Connections, pieces and live segments, drawn as they arrive
d1.title: 64 connections at once
d1.sub: Each download splits across up to 64 connections by default, and resumes right where it stopped
d2.title: Every piece, as it lands
d2.sub: A live piece map, with DHT, peer exchange and encryption built in
d3.title: Record it live
d3.sub: Pick your tracks and save HLS or DASH straight to MP4 or MKV
connect.preview: Preview before you download, then keep only the video, audio and subtitle tracks you want. Works together with the Rayburst desktop app.
engine.description: {aria2Next} is the open-source engine that powers Rayburst: aria2, actively maintained, with a long backlog of upstream bugs fixed and ED2K support added for the first time. HTTP, HTTPS, SFTP, Metalink, ED2K and BitTorrent, from the command line or over JSON-RPC.
engine.media: Native HLS and DASH as well: choose tracks, record live broadcasts, and save to MP4 or MKV without re-encoding.
engine.tag: Redefining the next generation of aria2
craft.title: Make it yours
craft.sub: Ten color schemes, light and dark, 27 languages. Try them on the real window
craft.nativeSub: Close the window and downloads carry on, with live speed in the menu bar.
craft.openSub: MIT licensed. Every line is on GitHub.
craft.pickSub: Choose the files in a torrent or magnet link, or the tracks of a stream, before it starts. Nothing else downloads.
features.concurrent.title: Many at once
features.concurrent.desc: Choose how many tasks and connections run side by side.
features.speed.title: Speed limits
features.speed.desc: Cap upload and download speed, globally or per task.
features.tracker.title: Fresh trackers
features.tracker.desc: Tracker lists stay in sync with the community.
features.handler.title: Your links, handled
features.handler.desc: Open magnet, ED2K and thunder links in Rayburst by default.
features.bt.title: Serious BitTorrent
features.bt.desc: Choose files, with DHT, peer exchange and encryption.
features.light.title: Feather light
features.light.desc: Built on Tauri and Rust for a small footprint.
dl.title: Get Rayburst
dl.note: Older releases may still carry the Motrix Next name.
dl.sub: Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux
dl.help.macOS: Apple menu → About This Mac → Chip
dl.connectSub: Sends what you find in the browser straight to Rayburst.
dl.engineSub: The engine on its own: a CLI, JSON-RPC and a Docker image.
dl.sponsorSub: Rayburst is free and open source. Your support keeps it moving forward.
